newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil hits new contract lows on soy losses.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil hits new contract lows on soy losses.

text.p: Extreme weakness in CBOT soybean futures pushed all nearby soyoil months to fresh contract lows in early trade Monday.
July, August, September and October soyoil made new contract lows.
CBOT soymeal futures also posted heavy losses in early trade. The sell-off in CBOT soybean futures was precipitated by technical weakness in the July contract, traders said.
July soybeans slid through key technical support at $8.20 per bushel and triggered a wave of sell-stop orders, floor traders said.
Near the open, Continental Grain bought 200 lots July soymeal and Prudential Securities sold 300 lots July, pit sources said.
